coverage.target: Agent reliability is measured by U17 measurement-tools; the harness makes no agent-reliability claim
Memory safety is delivered by U6 and U7 and checked by suite T10, whose content U7 owns; the harness is safe Rust with forbid(unsafe_code)
Portability of the harness is covered by Functional Design rules BR1.7, BR3.2, BR4.3 and BR7.7; no additional NFR requirement for this Unit
Runtime dependencies belong to U6; the harness is never linked into programs
Checked by suite T14, whose content U10 owns
